the structural and functional characterization of the quadruple K53,56,M mutant of recombinant PLA2 and the role of the second calcium in membrane binding and catalysis.
the elucidation of the role of the second calcium in PLA2.
the role of the second calcium binding site and the surface loop in intermolecular binding of PLA2.

the second calcium is involved in the binding to the membrane, and the surface loop residues Lys62, Asp66, and Tyr67 are involved in the catalysis of the interfacial hydrolysis of the phospholipid.
